title.zh: 【Onchain 基金会因币安攻击事件暂停 LSK 回购，预计将于下周恢复】
title.en: 【Onchain 基金会因币安攻击事件暂停 LSK 回购，预计将于下周恢复】

current_state.zh: The Onchain Foundation temporarily paused LSK buybacks due to a Binance attack and expects to resume next week, while Lisk advised liquidity providers to withdraw from the Uniswap ETH/LSK pool.
current_state.en: The Onchain Foundation temporarily paused LSK buybacks due to a Binance attack and expects to resume next week, while Lisk advised liquidity providers to withdraw from the Uniswap ETH/LSK pool.
